<thought>We need to retrieve polymorph data for up to 40 sulfide compositions, then consolidate, prepare a tabular dataset, train an XGBoost model, evaluate it, and save the results JSON. First step is to batch retrieve polymorphs for a representative list of sulfide formulas.</thought>
<action>batch_retrieve_polymorphs</action>
<action_input>{
    "compositions": [
        "FeS", "FeS2", "CuS", "Cu2S", "ZnS", "PbS", "CdS", "MoS2", "WS2",
        "NiS", "Ni3S2", "CoS", "Co9S8", "SnS", "SnS2", "Bi2S3", "Sb2S3",
        "Ag2S", "AgS", "Al2S3", "Ga2S3", "In2S3", "SiS2", "GeS2",
        "TiS2", "TiS", "V2S3", "V3S4", "MnS", "MnS2", "CrS", "Cr2S3",
        "ZrS2", "HfS2", "NbS2", "TaS2", "Y2S3", "Sc2S3", "La2S3", "Ce2S3"
    ],
    "max_energy_above_hull": 0.3,
    "max_per_composition": 3,
    "save_directory": "sulfides_data"
}</action_input>
